# Harishankar Kumaravel

Harishankar Kumaravel, also known as Harishankar K, is a visual and motion designer based in Tamil Nadu, India. He works on brand identities, packaging, campaigns, social media, print and motion graphics.

## What Harishankar works on

- Brand identities, logos and visual guidelines
- Packaging, brochures, catalogues, posters and banners
- Campaign ideas and social media content
- Motion graphics, video ads, explainers and social edits
- Interface layouts and prototypes in Figma

## Selected client experience

Harishankar has created work for Tata BlueScope Steel, Mizaj and Coromandel International, along with clients in real estate, retail, agriculture, architecture and lifestyle. His work has included campaign visuals, retail branding, event material, brochures, social content and motion graphics.
